Key Features & Advantages

Fast Cable Insertion

Hinged side plate opens easily to insert wire rope without detaching the end fitting.

Lubrication Port

Fitted with brass grease zerk for continuous smooth rotation under heavy line pulls.

Standards & Compliance

EN 13157 & ASME B30.26

Rigging hardware and pulley blocks.

CE Certified

150% proof load tested.

Product Overview

The Europull Snatch Block doubles winch pulling power and redirects winch cable around corners safely during recovery, mining, and tower erection.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Snatch Block are available?

The Europull Snatch Block is available in 7 models: EP-SB02, EP-SB04, EP-SB08, EP-SB15, EP-SB22, EP-SB30, EP-SB50. WLL (Tons) ranges from 2.0 Ton to 50.0 Ton. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Snatch Block cover?

The Europull Snatch Block covers 2t - 50t.

Which standard does the Europull Snatch Block comply with?

The Europull Snatch Block is manufactured to EN 13157 / ASME B30.26.

What sheave does the Europull Snatch Block have?

The Europull Snatch Block's sheave: Cast Steel Sheave with Bronze Bushing & Grease Fitting.

What side Opening does the Europull Snatch Block have?

The Europull Snatch Block's side Opening: Hinged Side Plate with Quick-Release Safety Latch.

What end Fitting does the Europull Snatch Block have?

The Europull Snatch Block's end Fitting: Drop-Forged 360° Swivel Hook or Shackle.

How do I request a quotation for the Europull Snatch Block?
